meta.name: story
meta.description: 网络小说工具箱主入口。根据用户需求自动路由到对应 skill，并可启动本地 Dashboard 查看拆文库、写作项目和编辑文本。触发方式：/story、$story、/story dashboard、$story dashboard、/网文、「我想写小说」「打开工作台」「检查更新」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 一键进入小说写作工作台，集中管理拆文库与文稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在写网络小说并希望一个入口集中管理拆文和文稿
copy.tagline_en: Open a fiction writing dashboard to manage clips and drafts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write web novels and want a single hub for materials and manuscripts.

howto.what: 装上后，AI 助手会变成网文工具箱的总入口：你提出写小说、拆文、扫榜等需求时，它会自动分派给对应的子技能，并处理初始化、版本检查等杂务。
howto.when: 当你说出“/story”“/网文”等命令，或说“我想写小说”“检查更新”时触发；意图不明确时也会由它来分发。

say.text: 我想写一部长篇小说，帮我开书。
say.note: 会路由到长篇写作工具。
会启动本地 Dashboard 查看项目。

say.text: 检查一下工具箱有没有新版本。
say.note: 会对比版本并提示是否更新。

howto.what_en: After installation, the AI assistant becomes the main entry for a web novel toolkit: when you make requests like writing a novel, analyzing chapters, or scanning rankings, it automatically routes to the corresponding sub-skill and handles initialization, version checks, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say commands like “/story” or “/网文”, or requests like “I want to write a novel” or “check for updates”; it also handles ambiguous intents.

say_en.text: I want to write a long novel, help me start one.
say_en.note: Routes to the long-form writing skill.
Starts the local dashboard to view projects.

say_en.text: Check if the toolkit has an update.
say_en.note: Compares versions and prompts to update.
